title: jmap-mail-types: metadata/privateMetadata fields and metadata filter conditions
description: Foundation for JMAP-s4kp.1 (Mark 2026-10-23, option A). In jmap-mail-types: add metadata and privateMetadata (Option<Map<String, Value>>) to Email and Mailbox and their patch handling. Let EmailFilterCondition and MailboxFilterCondition carry the six metadata-04 filter conditions at the leaf level so they survive FilterOperator trees (e.g. a Deserialize impl for jmap_metadata_server::WithMetadata<C> and Filter<WithMetadata<...>>, or equivalent); no out-of-band side list. Keep deny_unknown_fields for everything else. BREAKING. Siblings (s4kp.2-.7) add the same to their own types crates when they land.
